layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Therizinosaurus scythe-like claw morphology
features: A clay dinosaur forelimb with three exceptionally long, gently curved scythe-like claws
The claws are made of a dark, charcoal-grey clay with a semi-matte finish and subtle longitudinal grooves
The hand and arm are covered in a mix of shaggy, feathered clay textures in earthy browns and mossy greens
The claws are tapered to a sharp point, emphasizing their extreme length (nearly half the length of the arm)
The joints of the fingers are thick and muscular, rendered in a tactile 'sculpted' style
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic side-view shot of the three elongated claws. The lighting is positioned to create a strong silhouette against a neutral grey studio background, highlighting the 'Scythe' morphology icon. No text.
